svg.title: Symmetric coordinates for the isosceles trapezoid
svg.desc: The longer horizontal base joins A(-a,0) and D(a,0). The shorter base joins B(-b,c) and C(b,c). Both are centered on the vertical axis. An illustrative point P has coordinates (p,q); its location is not an assumption. Math Practice illustration of the coordinate method in MAA 2022 AMC 10A official solutions, page 18.
